description: Post balanced double-entry journal entries (debits must equal credits), void entries, and compute a trial balance on a JSON-backed ledger.
name: gl_entry
provider_notes: Local double-entry ledger via ctx.memory (key aul:gl_journal_v1). Not a certified accounting system and not a bank integration — entries are bookkeeping records only. Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
